class Count {
  const n: nat
  var x: int
  ghost var xs: seq<int>  // non-assignable
  ghost const _reads: set<object?>
  ghost const _modifies: set<object?>
  ghost var _new: set<object?>
  ghost const _decreases0

  constructor {:axiom} (n: nat)
    ensures this.n == n
    ensures this.xs == []
    ensures Valid()
    ensures this._reads == old({})
    ensures this._modifies == old({})
    ensures this._new == {}
    ensures this._decreases0 == old(n)
    decreases n

  ghost predicate {:axiom} Valid()
    reads this, this._reads, this._new
    decreases this._reads + this._new + {this}

  method {:axiom} MoveNext() returns (more: bool)
    requires Valid()
    modifies this, this._modifies, this._new
    ensures fresh(this._new - old(this._new))
    ensures null !in this._new
    ensures more ==> Valid()
    ensures this.xs == if more then old(this.xs) + [this.x] else old(this.xs)
    ensures more ==> 0 <= x < n
    decreases this._decreases0
}
type {:axiom} Count(==) = c: Count? | c != null /*special witness*/
